Based on the README, here are the steps to run Hugo locally:

1. First, make sure you have Hugo (Extended version) installed. Since you're on macOS, you can install it with:
```bash
brew install hugo
```

2. Then, to start the local development server, run:
```bash
hugo server -D
```

3. The site will be available at http://localhost:1313/

The `-D` flag tells Hugo to include draft content in the build. The site will automatically update as you make changes to the content.
